review_mode: Scheduled cloud dual-review; independent Codex desk
limitations: Confidence values are subjective evidence confidence, not return probabilities. News remains unweighted in the trading score.
The latest committed raw feed was fresh at review time and the Thursday PSX session was live under the repository calendar. EXCHANGE_HOLIDAYS is empty and SESSION_OVERRIDES is empty.
The National Refinery signing is verified from the linked Business Recorder article and NRL's PSX disclosure. Project cost, capex phasing, returns and near-term earnings impact are not quantified.
The raw Mettis refinery item carries a future timestamp relative to this review and is not used as timestamp evidence.
Existing current-session ratings are carried forward unchanged unless materially changed by verified evidence. Absence of a reviewed story is not treated as Neutral.

reviewed_stories.title: National Refinery formally signs brownfield Upgrade Agreement
reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Direct NRL contractual implementation milestone in the existing brownfield refinery upgrade thread.
reviewed_stories.reason: National Refinery Limited formally signed its Upgrade Agreement with Inter State Gas Systems under the amended brownfield refinery policy. This advances the earlier scheduled sector event to a completed NRL contractual milestone and supports refinery modernisation and supply-chain resilience. Project cost, capex phasing, returns and near-term earnings impact remain unquantified.
reviewed_stories.publication_time_status: Business Recorder page verified at September 24, 2026 1:50 PM PKT. NRL's PSX disclosure independently verifies the signing and is dated September 24, 2026.

ATRL.reason: ATRL executed its brownfield Upgrade Agreement with ISGS, converting the prior scheduled signing into a completed contractual milestone. The agreement supports refinery modernisation, efficiency and Euro-V fuel capability, but near-term earnings impact and project economics are not quantified.
ATRL.relevance: Direct link: ATRL is Attock Refinery Limited, the PSX-listed refinery that executed the agreement.

CNERGY.reason: CNERGY executed its brownfield Upgradation Agreement with ISGS, advancing the existing refinery-upgrade thread from a scheduled sector milestone to a completed company contract. The agreement covers its approved refinery upgrade, while project returns, capex phasing and near-term earnings impact remain unquantified.
CNERGY.relevance: Direct link: CNERGY is Cnergyico PK Limited, the PSX-listed refinery that signed the Upgradation Agreement.

NRL.reason: NRL formally signed its brownfield Upgrade Agreement with ISGS, advancing the earlier scheduled sector event to a completed company contractual milestone. The agreement supports refinery modernisation and supply-chain resilience, while project cost, capex phasing, returns and near-term earnings impact remain unquantified.
NRL.relevance: Direct link: NRL is National Refinery Limited, the PSX-listed refinery that signed the Upgrade Agreement.

KEL.reason: NEPRA's notified FY24-FY30 base tariff is 19% below the original determination, the tribunal rejected KE's appeal, and KE says the outcome has a substantial adverse impact and is financially unsustainable. Higher-court remedies remain possible.
KEL.relevance: Direct link: KEL is K-Electric Limited, the regulated utility affected by the MYT decision.

NML.reason: NML's 20MW solar and 35MWh battery project can reduce purchased-power exposure and improve reliability from March 2027. The separate Rs2.048bn dairy-stake sale is directionally unresolved because carrying value and use of proceeds are undisclosed.
NML.relevance: Direct link: NML is Nishat Mills Limited, the company signing the energy project and selling the dairy stake.

DGKC.reason: DGKC signed for a 25MW solar plant and 10MWh battery system at its Dera Ghazi Khan cement plant, with generation expected in March 2027. The project should lower purchased-power exposure, but capex and savings are not quantified.
DGKC.relevance: Direct link: DGKC is D.G. Khan Cement Company Limited and the project is at its cement plant.
